result.Method of Attack: SQL Injection via multiple stacked SQL statements allowing termination of read-only transaction with COMMIT; enabling arbitrary SQL execution including destructive commands; Session state manipulation via connection pool allowing persistent session variable changes affecting subsequent queries
result.Impacted Systems: Anthropic’s reference Postgres MCP server and databases accessed via the vulnerable MCP server
result.Attack Vector: User-supplied SQL query string allowing multiple statements separated by semicolons; Reuse of connection pool sessions without isolation
